title: Scoped census: late-compensated R439 helper entrances; only #1179's kernel pair survives the carrier-checked class, one triple stays open (no new kappa)
body:
**Scoped negative result with one open survivor. No construction, no new κ, and the selected record is unchanged.**

- Track: bit supplier, seed 9.
- Card: `bit-helper-contract`, with the scope **refined**.
- Base: `0b1cccf8`.
- Package: `research/r439-late-entrance-census-seed09/`.

## The open case this narrows

The inherited H2/K interface requires every helper to start at frame 0, so that a frame-0 prefix D supplies all dirt compensation. An entrance would let a helper start at a nonzero frame instead: a pivot p, with the gauge q ^= p on a support c. That changes the response by ρ = Kc, so the targets in T = supp ρ need compensation from somewhere else.

Merged work decides only T = ∅:
- **#1179** found the kernel entrance 444+470.
- **#1253** proved it unique among common-frame entrances (366 classes).

Two cases were left open by name:
- **#1128** PROOF §4 excludes "compensation moved after A".
- **#1179** says K e_J = 0 is "not a statement about arbitrary later compensation".

This PR **narrows** that case, for **compensation after the scatter** with A and the scatter fixed and one entrance at a time, to one open triple. It covers every one of #1253's 4,954 supports, plus 5,212 enumerated source-donor entrances (5,059 of them placeable), on the selected PR589 word and the four merged star words (#1062, #1122, #1188, #1208). The broader case of #1128 §4, compensation after A but before the scatter, is not covered.

## The test

For each target t, W_t is the **dirt-only space**: the helper parts of all source-free F2 combinations of the values that t can legally read after the scatter. A support is admitted only if every t ∈ T has some u ∈ W_t with u·c = 1.

There are three classes:

| Class | What t may read | Status of a REJECT |
|---|---|---|
| **LC-fav** | any register whose frame at the cut lies in t's final frame t⊥, plus the nine COPY snapshots | **Sound for the whole class** of post-scatter programs with monotone frames and the stated premises (`PROOF.md`: the cone lemma is #1128 §1's dependency-path argument; the monotone-span lemma is the dual of #1128 §2's erasure invariant). This is the necessary test. |
| **A6** | B ++ C unchanged, inserted target reads with a carrier check, read-only relays (reads during C reduce to the end of B: C is at FULL and touches no target, asserted) | Sound for A6. A6 is contained in LC-fav. |
| **A6R** | A6 plus storage relays, with restoration ignored | An over-approximation, used only to keep a survivor open. |

## Results

They are identical on all five words.

| | LC-fav | A6 |
|---|---|---|
| Admitted supports | 444+470 (T = ∅, #1179) and **444+470+578** (\|T\| = 8) | 444+470 only |
| Single helpers / new pairs | 0 / 439, 0 / 1,569 | 0 / 439, 0 / 1,569 |
| Source donors (5,212 enumerated, 5,059 placeable) | 0 kernel, 0 late | 0 kernel, 0 late |
| Relaxation (366 classes) | 1 nonzero class, kernel {444+470, 578} | 1 nonzero class, kernel {444+470} |
| max dim W_t | 5 | 4 |

**The triple 444+470+578 is OPEN.**
- A6 covers 2 of its 8 targets (150 and 197).
- A6R covers all 8.
- A6R restricted to relays inside T covers 4.

So, within A6R (B ++ C fixed, insertion-only target reads), covering all 8 needs storage relays outside T, which must later be restored. LC-fav also allows a rewritten B or C and fresh restored registers, which A6R does not model. It is handed on as open question 1.

**Why so little survives.** Every W_t is a *coordinate* subspace, spanned by at most 5 unit vectors (4 in A6). A target can compensate a support only where the support meets that set, and only 98 (47) of the 18,085 nonzero K incidences do.

## Correctness

- **Two engines.**
  - Engine 1 (`census.py`) does the packed-int replay and the parity census.
  - Engine 2 (`engine2.py`, no shared code) uses set-valued replay, rational annihilators, a kernel-method LC-fav and per-pair change points for A6.
  - They agree on K, the closure (which also equals **#1253's `CERTIFICATE.json`**), every W_t in both classes and every **support verdict**, on all five words. Engine 2 also checks that all 636 frames are closed, so label inclusion equals rational containment.
  - The source donors, the relaxation (checked to contain every admission), the scout class and A6R are computed by engine 1 only.
- **A realisable late entrance, on a synthetic word.** `W_syn` is PR589 with target 150's compensation of 470 moved after the scatter: three B reads into 150, and 470 dropped from D's row 150.
  - The census admits 444+470 there as a *late* entrance (T = {150}) in LC-fav and A6.
  - Its built witness passes the merged `wlib.replay`, and **fails at register 150 without its three late reads**. The witness is: start[444] = 79, the shear and its inverse, three post-scatter reads into 150, and D′ = PR589's D without 444.
  - Honest note: those late reads undo `W_syn`'s own moved compensation, so after B the witness carries the same values as #1179's prefix entrance on PR589. It shows that an admission can be realised; it is not a new construction.
  - Both words are rebuilt in code and checked by canonical sha256.
- **Mutations.** Flipping one K bit rejects the kernel pair. Letting register 77 be read at FULL admits the triple in A6. Emptying target 150's reads rejects the triple. A flipped word byte is rejected.
- **Sanity checks** of the census, true by construction:
  - with every unit vector added to every W_t, all supports are admitted;
  - the kernel pair is admitted;
  - clearing K's column 578 admits 578.
- **Checks run.**
  - `verify.py` gives `PASS_R439_LATE_ENTRANCE_CENSUS` in about 3 min, and RESULT.json is reproduced byte for byte.
  - 20 tests pass.
  - `research_package.py --check-only` passes.
  - The registered python3.12 replay gives `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` in 3 min 15 s.
  - These were run on Python 3.12.15 and 3.14.8 (macOS 26.5, arm64).
- **CI.** A red `verify (…, tests)` job is pre-existing on main (the stale spectrum-audit pin) and is not caused by this package. The repair is #1752.

## Scope

**Covered.** Single common-frame entrances, with fixed A and scatter and no pre-scatter wires, and with the endpoint required on all 661 columns.

**Not covered:**
- a changed A, targets leaving frame 0 before the scatter, a new COPY, or scatter changes beyond added snapshot terms;
- shears after A or at several frames;
- general source-dependent basis changes;
- simultaneous entrances (the joint test is stated in `PROOF.md` but not run);
- recursive interfaces and hosting.

**No κ.** The bit side does not bind, and an entrance's −H1 is cancelled by +H1 in width-8 hosting (#1179, #1253).

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-late-entrance-census-seed09/verify.py          # about 3 min; PASS_R439_LATE_ENTRANCE_CENSUS
python3 -I -B -m unittest discover -s research/r439-late-entrance-census-seed09 -p test_package.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-late-entrance-census-seed09
```

## Overlap and credit

- **#1179** (adamgall): the kernel pair. Its stream checks are proposed for a future witness of the triple; they are not run here.
- **#1253** (mightyOil): the closure and its certificate, reproduced here.
- **#1194** (woklerx) and **#1311** (Arham-Tahir64): the semantic-D contract.
- **The star words:** #1062 (ours), #1122 and #1188 (bitplane) and #1208 (ToikY). The helper-star D comes from #967 (theon199), built on #915/#926 (bitplane).
- **The R439 word, scatter and `xcheck_p.py`:** eumemic (#543/#555). The A-section transports and `wlib.py`: DreamingOfClouds (#589).
- **The helper-470/source-77 boundary behind the survivor:** #1043 (aliromman, open), #1079 (bbMisk / Hanson Sun) and #1256 (RossRichardson).
- **Kernel-entrance precedents:** #254 (Dugongue) and #382 (chafreaky).
- **Different mechanisms:** open #1810 (RossRichardson) and #1580/#1592 (Arham-Tahir64).

`find_overlap.py --refresh` found no work on late compensation of R439 entrances.

## Disclosure

Prepared by Sagar Thakrar (thakrarsagar) with substantial AI assistance from Claude (Anthropic) via Claude Code.
- Parallel read-only scout and judge subagents selected the question; both judges ranked it first.
- Reader subagents and a synthesizer audited the scout's criterion. They found the triple the scout had missed and the missing carrier check in its strict class.
- Both engines, the proof note and the controls were then written fresh.

- A post-PR adversarial review corrected the witness description, the open triple's scope, the citations and the controls (second commit).

No claim was posted to Discussions. New material is Apache-2.0.
